title: Cross-validation diagnostics for cat2cat ML models — cat2cat_ml_run
text: Three complementary metrics evaluate model quality: Accuracy measures often model's top prediction matches true category. Use care single likely assignment. Higher better; theoretical maximum 1.0. Mean P(true class) measures average probability model assigns correct category. evaluates full probability distribution, just top prediction. cat2cat, weights probabilities distributed across candidates, metric directly measures weight quality. Higher better; range \([0, 1]\). Brier score measures squared error predicted probability true outcome: \((1 - P(true))^2\). Unlike log-loss, Brier score bounded \([0, 1]\) explode P(true) near zero. Lower better; 0 means perfect prediction. k categories, naive baseline (uniform 1/k) gives Brier = \((1 - 1/k)^2\).
